databases-acquire-cancellation-counter.review_basis: The handler broadens Exception to BaseException. The existing queries-after-error test adds a cancellation parameter and checks subsequent queries. Counter recovery is not certified by syntax.

databases-commit-clears-backend.review_basis: The patch makes transaction backends task-local and clears _transaction after commit and connection exit. Tests cover distinct tasks, explicit connection sharing and transaction state. Runtime isolation is not established by static declarations.

databases-disconnect-local-state.review_basis: The patch replaces the task-local ContextVar in the non-global branch before backend disconnect. No new dedicated regression accompanies the patch; existing connect/disconnect tests are candidates only.

databases-transaction-context-isolation.review_basis: The patch uses copy_context and a nominated connection callable when a root transaction already exists. Its parallel transaction regressions are source evidence; a later revert is not proof that the observed patch is runtime-correct.

litestar-delete-many-chunking.review_basis: The patch replaces a fixed size with a caller-configurable helper and adds a chunked deletion regression. Flush/commit remains explicitly source-scoped; SQL parameter limits and successful deletion are not inferred.

litestar-repository-auto-commit.review_basis: The genuine change adds auto_commit and optional refresh/expunge paths. The lazy-load regression disables auto_refresh and explicitly commits before relationship assertions. The helper call does not itself prove which runtime branch executes.

litestar-update-fetched-values.review_basis: The patch adds refresh between flush and expunge. The new fetched-value regression commits, updates and asserts the database-fetched timestamp changes; that is test source, not an observed DB result.

litestar-update-session-merge.review_basis: The patch fetches the existing identifier before merging the incoming model; flush and expunge remain explicit. The changed mocked repository test asserts merge/flush/expunge and that commit was not called; it does not prove persisted database contents.

sqlalchemy-bulk-begin-flushing.review_basis: A new pending-rollback regression asserts _flushing is false and the Session can be used after rollback. The begin call moves into the outer try/finally; rollback remains an explicit inner exception call.

sqlalchemy-failed-begin-state.review_basis: The patch assigns the connection transaction only in the success else branch, retaining the temporary transaction while start is awaited. This is source state/exception syntax, not a successful-BEGIN assertion.

sqlalchemy-prepare-failure-rollback.review_basis: The patch wraps rollback in _expect_state(SessionTransactionState.CLOSED). The new two-phase prepare-failure test injects an exception, expects it and asserts the added object is no longer in the Session.

sqlalchemy-prepared-commit-xid.review_basis: The dialect replaces string interpolation with text/bindparam/literal_execute syntax. Shared two-phase execution tests remain relevant; source syntax alone does not establish driver binding or transaction success. Existing two-phase transaction source exercises prepare/commit/rollback and asserts final rows; no new dedicated quoted-XID regression is claimed.
